summary: CricTrack v3 major-feature rollout: full backend + mobile UI regression. All 20 backend pytest cases pass (100%) covering toss, MoM, undo, per-player batting/bowling stats, out_type + fielder_id validation, wide/bye bowler charging semantics, public share (no-auth) and ISO date storage. Mobile UI E2E (390x844) verified end-to-end: phone -> dev OTP -> profile-setup -> API-seeded 2 teams x 3 players -> new match -> /matches/{id}/toss loads -> pick winner + Bowl -> routes to /matches/{id}/setup?side=b (correct: team A elected bowl so B bats first) -> 3-step wizard (Striker -> Non-Striker -> Opening Bowler) -> Start Innings fires POST /innings/b/start -> match state becomes live with innings_b.started=true and current_innings='b'. Live screen shows striker/non-striker/bowler cards with photos, Scorecard + Share buttons in header, and Wicket + Undo + Wd/Nb/Bye/LB + run pads. Public /share/{token} renders LIVE badge, score, batting rows with striker '*' marker, bowling rows with 0.0-0-0/Econ, and 'Live updates every 5 seconds' hint — all without auth.
critical_code_review_comments: Toss logic correct: if winner elects bat -> current_innings equals side of winning team (a or b). If elects bowl -> current_innings flips to opposite side. Verified for team_a wins + bowl -> current_innings='b'.

Ball endpoint: (a) wicket=true without out_type -> 400 with 'Select how the batsman was out'; (b) out_type in {catch_out, run_out, stumped} without fielder_id -> 400 'Select the fielder for this dismissal'; (c) bowled/catch_out/lbw/stumped/hit_wicket credit bowler.wickets, run_out and retired_hurt do NOT.

Per-player stats: striker.balls increments on every legal ball EXCEPT wide; striker.runs only for off-bat (extra='none'); fours/sixes counted only on 'none' 4/6; bowler.runs excludes byes/leg-byes; bowler.extras counts wide+no_ball; bowler.balls only for legal deliveries.

Undo restores full pre-snapshot (runs, balls, wickets, striker_id, non_striker_id, dismissed_ids, batters, bowlers, batted_ids) and clears completed/last_ball; also demotes match.status from completed -> live and clears winner_team_id/result_text.
Public /api/public/matches/{share_token} strips owner_id from match & both teams; returns team_a.players & team_b.players. 404 for unknown token. No auth required.
MoM endpoint validates team_id must be team_a_id or team_b_id; sets both man_of_the_match_id and man_of_the_match_team_id and persists.
Tournament ISO date '2026-03-09' persists round-trip on GET. Frontend tournaments/create.tsx uses regex ^([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{1,2})/([0-9]{4})$ and posts YYYY-MM-DD; alerts on malformed input.
Setup wizard (setup.tsx) gates the Next button by step (striker/nonStriker/bowler each required) and only fires POST /innings/{side}/start when step===2 (bowler) and Start Innings pressed.
